tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Bennett expressing desire-1, using only the supplied approved neutral as image reference. Preserve identity, face, skin tone, hair, eyes, costume, accessories, colors and rendering. Preserve his petite Medium Male proportions, goggles, white hair and adventurer outfit. Give this emotion its own expressive full-body acting, genuinely varying leg positions, stance, body angle and gestures rather than locking the neutral pose: clearly legible heartfelt longing, flushed cheeks, soft open eyes and a hopeful gaze, a slight forward lean and one foot subtly ahead, one hand near the heart and the other relaxed; wholesome and fully clothed. Heart eyes, hearts in eyes: both eyes visibly open; retain original iris colors, outlines, shading and a visible colored border, with one solid pale green heart-shaped pupil centered in each iris. Hearts are pupils, not highlights or floating symbols. Hands should be simple and readable; each visible hand has one anatomically correct thumb and four fingers connected to one palm and wrist. Do not force hidden digits into view. Exactly two coherent legs and feet; varied bends, steps, stances and angles are welcome. Keep the complete silhouette including hair, headwear, accessories, hands and shoes visible, roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding, without lengthening the body. True transparent background. No scenery, text, UI, weapons, handheld objects, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
